sentences.text:
Counsel for Applicant :- Lalla Chauhan Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Uttam Kumar Awasthi Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
Heard Mr. Lalla Chauhan, learned counsel for the applicant, Mr. Jayant Singh Tomar, learned A.G.A-I for the State and Mr. Uttam Kumar Awasthi, learned counsel for the informant.
The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.492 of 2022, under Section 376 I.P.C., registered at Police Station Sandi, District Hardoi.
The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of an F.I.R. lodged on 16.12.2022 in furtherance of an application under Section 156 (3) Cr.P.C. against the applicant and his wife Pooja Soni.

The informant has stated in the first information report that the applicant is her mausa and the co-accused Pooja Soni is her mausi; that on 12.08.2022 the informant had gone to the house of the accused persons to attend the birthday party of their son when the co-accused Pooja Soni offered some cold drink to the informant and her mother and after consuming the same the informant and her mother fell unconscious and the applicant raped the informant.
The State has filed counter affidavit annexing therewith the copies of medico legal examination report and the statements of witnesses.

In the statement of the informant recorded under Section Abhishek Soni vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin.Secy. Home on 23 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/180134995/
1 161 Cr.P.C. she has reiterated the first information report version but in the medico legal examination report no external injury has been found on any part of her body and no opinion has been given regarding alleged sexual assault.

sentences.text: The copy of the charge sheet has also been annexed with the counter affidavit, which indicates that the In the affidavit filed in support of bail application it has been stated that the applicant is innocent, he has been falsely implicated in the present case and he has no criminal history.
The learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail but could not dispute the aforesaid aspects of the matter.

Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that although in the first information report the informant has levelled allegation against the applicant and her wife, the allegations levelled against the applicant's wife have not been established during investigation and the allegation levelled against the applicant are prima facie not supported by the medico legal examination report of the alleged victim; that the applicant has no previous criminal history and he is languishing in jail since 19.12.2022 and without making any observation,
which may affect the merits of the case, I am satisfied that the applicant is entitled to be enlarged on bail in the aforesaid case crime.
Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.
In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the prosecution shall be at liberty to move bail cancellation application before this Court.

Ram.
